notes: This lock pins requirements and records the versions the suite was run with. It does not vendor or download tools.
Platform prerequisites: Python >= 3.9 (standard library only) and a C11 compiler reachable as cc, gcc or clang. ARC1_CC selects one of the candidates.
A compiler not listed under tested is allowed but reported by `arc1 doctor` as an untested-toolchain warning.
No ARC-1 target (RISC-V F133) cross-compiler is locked yet; target builds are out of scope for M0-M1.
